agreement_page.title: User Agreement & Privacy Policy
agreement_page.agree_hint: Read and accept this agreement to continue. If you disagree, exit the app.
agreement_page.agreed: You have accepted this agreement. Updated terms will be shown in the app again.
agreement_page.user_intro: Welcome to WorkPlan with AI (the “App”), a local-first tool for tasks, notes, passwords, worklog and payroll. Read this agreement fully, especially the cloud sync, password vault, bank statement import and AI terms.
agreement_page.service_desc: The App runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android and provides task boards, templates, scheduled tasks, notes, a password vault, worklog and payroll statistics, cloud sync and AI assistance. Some features depend on cloud databases, AI providers or Bitwarden / Vaultwarden servers that you configure.
agreement_page.account_desc: You are responsible for your device, system account, Access Key, vault master password, recovery code and sync credentials. Loss caused by a lost device, forgotten master password, leaked recovery code or Access Key is your responsibility. Task data is local by default; cloud sync is optional.
agreement_page.sync_desc: When enabled, notes, vault and worklog data are encrypted locally before upload; task data itself is not uploaded as ciphertext by default. The Access Key is a data namespace, not a decryption key. Encrypted data can only be recovered with the same Access Key and the correct vault master password. The cloud provider may still see connection times and data sizes.
agreement_page.vault_title: 4. Password vault and third-party password services
agreement_page.vault_desc: Vault entries are encrypted locally with a key derived from the master password. You may import from or push to a Bitwarden / Vaultwarden server you configure. Login credentials are used only for that operation and are not stored. Availability, backups, access control and data handling of third-party servers are their operator's responsibility. Accounts with two-step login or Argon2 may not be supported yet.
agreement_page.user_resp_desc: Use the App lawfully. Do not use it to store or process illegal content, infringe rights or disrupt third-party services. You are responsible for content you enter, import or save from AI and for the consequences. Back up important data regularly.
agreement_page.ai_desc: AI features send the conversation, attachments, notes or task context you select to the model provider you configure. AI output may be inaccurate and is not legal, financial, medical or career advice. File writes, deletions and bulk changes require confirmation before execution. Ensure uploaded content does not infringe rights or contain information that should not be shared with a third party.
agreement_page.worklog_desc: Worklog, leave, salary components, actual pay and bank statement imports are used for local statistics and estimates. You choose and parse bank statements locally; the original file is not uploaded automatically, and imported results are stored in local salary records. Bank presets and field mappings are conveniences and do not guarantee every transaction is recognized. Overtime pay, leave deductions and salary estimates are for reference only; your employer and bank records prevail.
agreement_page.ip_desc: The App's code, interface and documentation belong to the author or respective rights holders and are open source under AGPL-3.0. Data you enter, import or create belongs to you. Third-party services are governed by their own terms.
agreement_page.disclaimer_desc: The App is provided “as is”, without guarantees of uninterrupted or error-free operation or compatibility with every device. The author is not liable for direct or indirect loss caused by use or inability to use the App. Keep your own backups and handle important data carefully.
agreement_page.changes_desc: This agreement may be updated as features change; material changes will be shown in the App. Continued use after an update means acceptance. Report issues through the project repository.
agreement_page.collect_desc: Local data includes tasks, notes, encrypted vault entries, worklog, leave, salary records, settings and AI conversations. With cloud sync enabled, only the selected notes, vault and worklog data (encrypted) and task plaintext are uploaded. AI requests send the context you select. We do not intentionally collect unrelated personal information.
agreement_page.usage_desc: Data is used to provide task management, notes, the password vault, worklog and payroll statistics, cloud sync, AI calls, import/export, troubleshooting and security. We do not sell your data.
agreement_page.storage_desc: Local data is stored in the device app-data directory. Cloud sync data is stored in the Supabase / PostgreSQL or compatible service you configure; vault and worklog sync are end-to-end encrypted. Android exports may be written outside the app directory; manage them yourself.
agreement_page.sharing_desc: We do not sell or share data with third parties except the cloud database, AI providers, Bitwarden / Vaultwarden servers and system file pickers you configure. Their processing is governed by their privacy policies.
agreement_page.security_desc: The vault is encrypted with keys derived from the master password. Cloud sync uses a master-password-wrapped account key and purpose-specific subkeys. The master password and Vaultwarden login password are not stored. No system is absolutely secure; use a strong master password, keep your recovery code safe and protect your device.
agreement_page.rights_desc: You can view, edit, export or delete local data, disable cloud sync, delete cloud data or use the in-app data deletion feature. Back up first; cloud backup removal may depend on the provider's retention policy.
